# Fatih Serdar Çakmak

> SOC analyst intern at Fibabanka (BDDK-regulated banking SOC) and Computer
> Engineering student at Istanbul Technical University (ITU), graduating 2027.
> Works on SIEM/SOAR/EDR alert triage, detection engineering, and incident
> response, and builds open-source AI/LLM security tooling on the side.
> Based in Istanbul, Turkey.

## Focus areas

- Security operations: SOC operations, alert triage, incident response, threat detection, log analysis, CTI, SIEM, SOAR (Cortex XSOAR), EDR/NDR, MITRE ATT&CK
- AI / LLM security: prompt injection defense, PII redaction, MCP (Model Context Protocol) security, LLM-assisted triage
- SOC automation with n8n; detection-as-code

## Projects

- [Tamga](https://github.com/yatuk/tamga): Self-hosted LLM security proxy in Go/Python/Next.js. Inline PII redaction (TC Kimlik, IBAN, credit cards), secret leak blocking, and prompt-injection detection with sub-millisecond Aho-Corasick scanning. Ships KVKK/BDDK/GDPR/PCI-DSS mappings, hash-chained audit logs, and a 309-prompt adversarial CI suite. AGPL-3.0.
- [MCPRadar](https://github.com/yatuk/mcpradar): Security scanner for Model Context Protocol servers. Detects tool poisoning, prompt injection, and supply-chain rug pulls; SARIF output for the GitHub Security tab; SQLite snapshot diffing. Published on PyPI. MIT.
- [İTÜ MCP](https://github.com/yatuk/itu-mcp): Local MCP server connecting ITU Ninova (LMS) and OBS (student portal) to Claude, Cursor, and Codex. Local-first; credentials never leave the machine. MIT.
- [SOC n8n Workflows](https://github.com/yatuk/soc-n8n-workflows): 10 production-shaped SOC automation playbooks for n8n — LLM-assisted alert triage, phishing analysis, IOC enrichment, human-approved containment, CVE watch, reporting.
- [SOC Simulation](https://github.com/yatuk/soc-simulation): End-to-end SIEM/SOAR case study (127 alerts, 126 false positives, 1 real threat) mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
- [İTÜ Ders Arşivi](https://github.com/yatuk/itu-archive): Independent archive of ITU's course schedule and academic calendar, scraped daily since OBS only publishes the current term. 27 terms back to 2016, 64,000+ section records. Live at https://itu-ders.com.
